text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PDR-7432 fired for inference-runtime-prod — error_rate > 5% (02:15 UTC). Triggered by anomaly detector on token-error-rate. Link: https://pagerduty.example/pdr/PDR-7432

pagerduty-bot: Alert assigned to primary: @marta (oncall). Waiting for ACK. If no ACK in 90s will escalate to secondary.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation triggered — paging secondary @raj (no ack from primary within 90s).

marta: Acked — sorry I was stepping away for a sec, oncall here, looking now.

marta: Quick triage: seeing 500s from model-serving pods: "model-shim" mounting errors + KV cache errors. Running: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide`

raj: I got the escalated page. I'll check the ingress/proxy + autoscaler. Ping @sam for infra-side node state.

sam: On it. Checking GPU pool. `kubectl describe pod inference-runtime-abc -n inference` shows long Init:0/1 with mount errors to /models/shard-3. Also kernel logs show nfs: server not responding.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: primary acknowledged but no mitigation update in configured window -> paging manager @jess.

marta: I restarted the replica set (rs-runtime-2026) to spin fresh pods; error rate dipped a little but kept bubbling. Looks like NFS timeouts cause shards to fail intermittently.

raj: NFS timeouts would break model loads. I'm initiating traffic shift to fallback model variant `model-quantized-v2` for latency-tolerant routes. Command:```
# shift 30% traffic to fallback
routeshift --service inference-runtime --from model-shim --to model-quantized-v2 --percent 30 --reason "NFS mount instability"
```

marta: Doing a canary now. Monitoring 1m windows.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation to manager @jess (manager-on-call) — manager notification: PDR-7432.

jess: Joining bridge. What's customer impact and ETA for fix?

marta: Customer impact: approx 2% of total requests returned 500 between 02:14–02:24 UTC (peak). Affected customers: acme-inc, dataflow-ai orgs; streaming responses also saw retries/timeouts.

raj: After shifting 30% traffic, error_rate is down to ~0.5% within 2 minutes on the canary. Looks promising.

marta: Digging into node-gpu-12 — kernel logs show repeated "rpc: server unavailable" and later OOM-kernel messages; restarting node fixed mount points and pods recovered.

sam: I'll cordon + drain node-gpu-12 and recreate it. Also adding a temporary alert to autoscaler for pods stuck in Init > 2m. Follow-up task: investigate NFS cluster health and mount timeout tuning.

jess: Thanks. Please document mitigation steps on the incident bridge and open a postmortem. Severity S2 — assign owners: sam (infra), raj (runtime), marta (oncall lead). Add follow-ups: stricter mount timeouts, fallback model traffic policy, autoscaler tuning, test runbook for node replacement.

marta: Noted — will add runbook steps and post notes. Current status: traffic shifted, node replaced, error-rate back to baseline. Monitoring 15m.

incident-bot: Incident PDR-7432 marked mitigated at 02:30 UTC. Pager closed.

raj: Quick follow-up — recommend we create an automated route that defaults non-critical routes to quantized fallback when model mount failures detected. Will propose in runtime RFC.

sam: I'll schedule a run of NFS health checks and raise an ops ticket for the storage team.

jess: Good work. After-action: include customer outreach plan for acme-inc + dataflow-ai. Assign comms to CS.

marta: Adding that to the incident notes. Closing thread after postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
